referees.quote: in view of the limited accuracy in the determination of the oscillation periods... this work does not appear suitable for publication in Nature Physics.
The authors' response to my comments is satisfactory, and so I recommend publication.

note: The file begins after a transfer: the manuscript was previously reviewed at another journal (first-round reports there are not included). The first round here is 'Version 0' at Nature Physics, which is what is reported. R1 does not use the scale words; 'does not appear suitable for publication in Nature Physics' maps to reject. R3 recommends publication with no further changes requested. Under the stated rule, 'publish as is' maps to 'minor revision', although it could arguably be read as 'accept'. Referee 2 is mentioned by R3 and the authors but has no report in this file, so R2 is not listed.
